svg.title: Updated metadata-driven ingestion framework flow
svg.desc: Database-first end-to-end flow from target selection and BRD ingestion through metadata discovery, stage-specific mapping, generated artifact registration, runtime activation, queue execution, target commit, watermark commit, and finalization. Every stage identifies the tables it reads or writes.
svg.text: Updated Metadata-Driven Framework - Database First
BRD and design artifacts -> approved target-resident metadata -> generated artifact -> queue-driven execution
PHASE 1 - TARGET PLATFORM SETUP AND SOURCE ONBOARDING
0. Project initialization and target selection
Source type = DATABASE; choose Databricks, Snowflake, or Fabric before any metadata read/write.
Storage: application project configuration (not one of the eight ingestion tables)
Databricks adapter
Delta / Databricks SQL
Snowflake adapter
Snowflake SQL repository
Fabric adapter
Lakehouse / Warehouse repository
1. Bootstrap the target metadata schema
Create or migrate exactly eight tables through a versioned, idempotent platform migration.
Writes schema only: cfg_source_system, cfg_connection, cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping, ctl_ingestion_queue, ctl_run, ctl_error_log, ctl_watermark
2. One-time source onboarding
Register the logical source system, JDBC endpoint, auth type, versioned connection JSON, and secret references.
Validate connectivity and JSON contract before activation. Secret values are never stored.
Writes: cfg_source_system -> cfg_connection
PHASE 2 - BRD, KPI, SOURCE DISCOVERY, AND APPROVED DESIGN EVIDENCE
3. BRD ingestion and design-run creation
Create the BRD workflow run, store the document artifact, and persist resumable application state.
Writes: brd_run_registry, kpi_checkpoints, ai_store
4. Requirement and KPI extraction with Gate 1 review
LLM proposes requirements and KPIs; deterministic checks and HITL approve the design artifacts.
Reads/writes: ai_store, kpi_checkpoints, hitl_review_queue
5. Table nomination and Gate 2 review
Nominate source tables from KPI evidence; a human approves the source feeds to discover.
Writes: ai_store.TABLE_NOMINATIONS, ai_store.GATE2_CERTIFIED_TABLES, hitl_review_queue
No cfg table is authoritative yet.
6. Database metadata discovery
Discover approved table schema, columns, datatypes, nullability, keys, ordinals, and relationships.
Writes raw evidence: ai_store and kpi_checkpoints
Discovery evidence is design-time input, not runtime configuration.
7. Create draft Source-to-Bronze objects
Create one object per approved source table or controlled query.
object_kind = INGESTION; processing_stage = SOURCE_TO_BRONZE; active_flag = false.
Writes: cfg_ingestion_object
8. Column profiling, semantic enrichment, and Gate 3 review
Profile nulls, cardinality, ranges, and numeric distribution; approve meanings and key candidates.
Writes evidence: ai_store.COLUMN_PROFILES, kpi_checkpoints, hitl_review_queue
Profiling statistics remain in ai_store; only approved execution decisions become cfg_mapping.
Design-time / runtime boundary rule
ai_store keeps prompts, nominations, profiles, reviews, and generated artifact evidence.
The eight target-resident tables contain the complete approved execution contract and runtime state.
Generated execution must never query ai_store.
Current BRD run_id is separate from ctl_run.run_id.
BRD/design run tracks design work; ctl_run tracks one actual data-processing attempt.
PHASE 3 - STAGE MAPPINGS, CODE GENERATION, EXECUTION SPECIFICATION, AND ACTIVATION
9. Source-to-Bronze mapping materialization
Create one mapping row per Bronze output column from the approved discovery/enrichment contract.
Set one bundle mapping_version/hash; is_current = true; active_flag = false.
Writes draft: cfg_mapping; updates draft cfg_ingestion_object
10. Bronze code generation and review
Generate from the approved current draft. The generator may not invent unapproved mappings.
Register the target artifact and verify its hash after review.
Reads: cfg_connection, cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping | Evidence: ai_store, hitl_review_queue
11. Register Bronze execution specification and activate
Write execution_spec_json: execution mode, target platform, engine, artifact URI/entry point,
artifact_hash, generator version. Recompute config_hash and atomically activate object + mappings.
Writes: cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping; initializes ctl_watermark only for incremental/CDC objects
Runtime cannot see the object until the executable artifact is registered and hash-verifiable.
12. Silver Mapping Resolution and review
Expand the existing merge-key step to include casts, renames, defaults, validation, dedupe, and merge keys.
Create object_kind = TRANSFORMATION and BRONZE_TO_SILVER mapping bundle; keep runtime-inactive.
Writes draft: cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping | Review: hitl_review_queue
13. Silver generation, artifact registration, and activation
Generate only from the approved Silver mapping; register and hash-verify the target-specific artifact.
Write execution_spec_json, recompute config_hash, and atomically activate Silver object + mappings.
Reads/writes: cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping | Evidence: ai_store, hitl_review_queue
14. Gold model, mapping, dependency design, and review
Create one TRANSFORMATION object per fact/dimension. Define all Silver inputs, joins, aggregations,
build order, output columns, validation, and ALL_SUCCESS dependency rules. Keep runtime-inactive.
Writes draft: cfg_ingestion_object.dependency_objects_json; cfg_mapping input/join/aggregation JSON
Review must compare expected vs computable facts/dimensions; silently excluding a Gold table is forbidden.
15. Gold generation, artifact registration, and activation
Generate every approved fact/dimension; register execution_spec_json and verify artifact_hash.
Atomically activate each Gold object and its SILVER_TO_GOLD mapping bundle.
Reads/writes: cfg_ingestion_object, cfg_mapping | Evidence: ai_store, hitl_review_queue
PHASE 4 - ACTUAL DATA EXECUTION, RECOVERY, AND CONTROL TABLES
16. Submit bounded work
Schedule/manual/event trigger creates logical_work_id, idempotency_key, exact work_scope_json,
batch correlation, and frozen metadata_snapshot_id.
Writes: ctl_ingestion_queue (PENDING)
17. Atomically claim work and create attempt
Conditional claim writes a unique claim token, lease, heartbeat, and attempt count; create a new run_id.
Updates: ctl_ingestion_queue (RUNNING) | Inserts: ctl_run (RUNNING)
18. Resolve frozen configuration and executable
Load exact active versions/hashes; validate JSON, object_kind, dependencies, boundary rules,
execution_spec_json, and artifact_hash. Never switch metadata during the run.
Reads: all four cfg tables + ctl_watermark | Updates: ctl_run.current_phase
19. Execute, validate, and commit target
INGESTION: connect and extract JDBC boundary. TRANSFORMATION: read governed Bronze/Silver inputs.
Apply mappings, controlled transformations, validation gates, lineage, and idempotent write strategy.
Updates: ctl_run phases, metrics, validation_status, target_write_id, target_commit_status
20. Commit watermark safely
After target commit and blocking validation, stage candidate and compare-and-swap watermark_version.
Updates: ctl_watermark; records watermark status in ctl_run
21. Finalize execution
ctl_run = SUCCESS -> ctl_ingestion_queue = SUCCESS -> release lease
Failure path
At every caught runtime error:
1. Insert ctl_error_log
Run, queue, attempt, object, stage,
safe details, retryable flag.
2. Keep watermark unchanged
Unless it already committed and recovery
verifies that durable state.
3. Update ctl_run
FAILED, current phase, recovery action,
target and watermark commit states.
4. Update ctl_ingestion_queue
RETRY_WAIT or FAILED according to the
versioned retry policy and lease.
Recovery is phase-aware and idempotent.
Later SFTP, ADLS/S3, and REST sources reuse this lifecycle; only connector, container handler, parser, and source-scope contracts change.
